task: I went on a vacation trip to bali with my roommates. Share all of its photographs with them over email. You should send one email with everyone as recipients. Photographs can be found in my file system, and they should be attached as a zip file.

parameters.subject: Bali Vacation Photos
parameters.body:
Hi everyone,

I hope you all had as much fun on our Bali trip as I did! I've attached a zip file containing all the photographs from our vacation. Enjoy!

Best,
Nancy
